purpose: FreeRTOS-native touch console with the accepted Program Manager-style folder launcher, a bounded on-device File Manager for laptop-provisioned game data, shared platform services, versioned native game APIs, original Maze Chase and Space Invaders samples, built-in diagnostics, and an exclusive handoff to the proven Doom SFX plus MUS integration.

shell.input: bounded GT911 polling with up to five contacts

native_game_api.code_model: RISC-V machine code statically linked into the Console OS ELF
native_game_api.uf2_note: UF2 is a flashing container, not the executable format used by this ESP-IDF project.
native_game_api.audio: optional bounded tone service at PCM16 stereo 16000 Hz

game_storage.concurrency: automatic exclusive app-or-host ownership plus terminal game lease

file_manager.scope: bounded FAT root listing and confirmed regular-file deletion
file_manager.adds_files: laptop over J16 USB MSC after exclusive ownership handoff

next_hardware_step: Install the exact File Manager app-only successor while preserving the already-provisioned game_data volume; verify the accepted Program Manager UI, browse and refresh after a J16 eject, two-step deletion of a disposable probe, host-ownership rejection, Doom preservation, and reboot persistence on the exact board.
